sub_sector.value: HVAC and plumbing supplies; industrial lubricants; architectural building products

manufacturing_type.detail: Manufactures evaporator coils and air handlers, formulates lubricants and sealants, and fabricates architectural railing assemblies.

production_model.detail: Distributes standard grilles, registers, and diffusers and manufactures custom architectural building components.

product_complexity.detail: Patented HVAC accessories, high-performance lubricants, and code-compliant fire and smoke protection systems.

production_role.detail: Manufactures finished air handlers, lubricants, and opening protection systems, along with evaporator coils and other components.

end_market_exposure.detail: Residential and commercial HVAC and plumbing, commercial construction, industrial maintenance, mining, oilfields, and rail.

notes: Make-to-stock is inferred from the distribution of standard product lines.
